# third_party/rpi-rgb-led-matrix

Vendored sources of [hzeller/rpi-rgb-led-matrix](https://github.com/hzeller/rpi-rgb-led-matrix)
(GPL-2.0, see `COPYING`). Compiled automatically by `build.rs` — no separate
install and no `RGB_MATRIX_DIR` required.

Only the C/C++ library sources are included (not the Python API, examples, or
`.o` build artifacts). Do not edit these files casually; prefer upstream.
